title: Prabowo accuses MSCI of trying to intimidate Indonesia after market rout
paragraphs: Prabowo accuses MSCI of trying to intimidate Indonesia after market rout
MSCI warned last week it was considering demoting Indonesia's equities to "standalone" market status, triggering a record-breaking market rout.

JAKARTA: Global index provider MSCI was trying to "intimidate" Indonesia but the country would not be afraid, President Prabowo Subianto told his Cabinet on Wednesday (Oct 21), striking a combative tone in his first public reaction to last week's downgrade warning.
